description: Source code for a Scala class implementing a rolling file appender with optional compression, used in Spark for logging purposes.

classes.name: RollingFileAppender
classes.description: A class that appends data to a file and manages rolling over the file based on size or policy, with optional compression.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the appender, performing any necessary cleanup.

methods.name: appendToFile
methods.description: Appends bytes to the file, rolling over if needed.

methods.name: rollover
methods.description: Handles the process of rolling over the current log file.

methods.name: rotateFile
methods.description: Performs the actual file rotation, with optional gzip compression.

methods.name: rolloverFileExist
methods.description: Checks if a rollover file already exists.

methods.name: moveFile
methods.description: Moves the active log file to a new rollover file.

methods.name: deleteOldFiles
methods.description: Deletes old rollover files exceeding retention limit.
